tools.name: list_versions
tools.description: List available snapshot versions for a project. Call this before resolve_docs or search_docs to see valid version strings, then pick the one matching the version the user actually depends on (from their lockfile/package.json) rather than guessing.

tools.name: report_missing_docs
tools.description: Best-effort report of public documentation missing from llmref. Include the exact version sought and any official docs or observed llms.txt URL already found during the task; scoped /docs or versioned llms.txt files are supported. tools.name: resolve_docs
tools.description: Resolve a concrete project version or `latest` to documentation and artifact URLs. Discover valid version strings with list_versions first. Save resolved_version and, when present, revision_id. Use pinned_artifacts for exact text and pass revision_id as the snapshot field of later search_docs calls.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "report_missing_docs" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Best-effort report of public documentation missing from llmref. Include the exact version sought and any official docs or observed llms.txt URL already found du…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: resolve_docs · Private data: report_missing_docs · Public sink: report_missing_docs.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: resolve_docs · Private data: report_missing_docs · Public sink: report_missing_docs

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_projects" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
